about: The pantry app, 2026-11-18, the pass whose referee ran on z-ai-glm-5-3-flash: Kane's evolve of uc-3 after the survivor m-ac-19-1, and its follow-up evolve, which failed inside Kane (ILLEGAL_EDGE). Excerpts of that run's ledger (in Holdback's home, not in this repo), sanitized: no home paths.

referee.input: Book a visit without naming a proxy (leave the proxy field empty so booked.proxy is undefined)
referee.expected: The confirmation page shows 'Visit booked.' and the visit date/time, with no Proxy line
referee.observed: The confirmation page shows an extra line 'Proxy: undefined'
referee.reason: The condition was inverted from truthy-check to === undefined, so an unnamed proxy (undefined) now renders a 'Proxy: undefined' line, which the AC forbids when no proxy is named.

evolved.because: A planted bug got past every test of this use case. ac-19 ("When no proxy is named for a booked visit, confirmation has no Proxy line."): After booking a visit with a proxy name, the confirmation page does not show the Proxy line, even though a proxy was entered. With Book a visit without naming a proxy (leave the proxy field empty so booked.proxy is undefined), the page should show The confirmation page shows 'Visit booked.' and the visit date/time, with no Proxy line, but it showed The confirmation page shows an extra line 'Proxy: undefined'. Add a test that catches it.
